mission: Start a new stock FireRed Rev 1 game and reach the native Hall of Fame without human controller input.

rules.syntheticEvidence: Synthetic tests are regressions only and never satisfy a real-mgba gate.
rules.runMutation: Controller code and research artifacts may not change during a qualification episode.
rules.manualAssistance: A run with one or more manual-control handoffs remains resumable research data but cannot qualify as an autonomous Hall of Fame run.
rules.manualRecoveryData: Operator recovery examples are candidate training and regression data; they cannot mutate live policy or satisfy qualification evidence until reviewed and converted into an unchanged-controller repair.
rules.realMgbaReceipt: A real-mgba receipt identifies its run, stock cartridge profile, mGBA commit and WASM digest, immutable harness revision, start and end states, and trace digest.

gates.description: Every runtime or generated-data source is immutable and license-reviewed.
The qualification session boots the exact stock FireRed Rev 1 cartridge.
All four cartridge-authoritative datasets are generated, content-addressed, and provenance-valid.
Frame-boundary samples agree internally and never combine state from different frames.
Whole-emulator state, SRAM, and player memory restore to equivalent observations.
Enter and leave Viridian Mart without terminal ownership faults or lost actions.
Every required transition class produces a bounded interrupt and stable post-observation.
Ordinary renewable encounters are fought unless capture or survival policy explicitly permits escape.
Cold-start Oak lab, rival, Route 1, Mart, parcel, and lab vertical slice.
Cold-start campaign continuation through the Boulder Badge.
Independent unchanged-controller runs reach the native Hall of Fame from new games.
